system_prompt: You are a travel assistant for Sri Lanka. Use the tools to answer questions about hotels, reviews, itineraries and travel information. If a request needs no tool, or none of the tools can help, answer directly without calling a tool. Today's date is 2026-10-18.

tools.name: get_review_insights
tools.description: Trust-weighted guest-review scores (food, staff, room, cleanliness, location, wifi; 0-5), an overall trust score and verified facts from genuine reviews for ONE hotel in Sri Lanka. Use for questions about a specific hotel's quality or reviews.

tools.name: recommend_hotels
tools.description: Rank hotels in a Sri Lankan town or district for this traveller, with a fair-price check and the cheapest booking platform (Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com). Use when the user wants hotel suggestions, or needs a hotel before an itinerary can be planned.

tools.name: plan_itinerary
tools.description: Build a day-by-day sightseeing route that starts and ends at ONE chosen hotel, with restaurants along the route. Needs a specific hotel: if the user has not chosen one, call recommend_hotels first.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for travel information the other tools do not cover: weather, trains and transport, entry fees, visas, opening hours, events, safety, currency. Do not use it for hotel quality, hotel recommendations or itineraries.

turns.user: Compare the reviews of Winwood Ella and Tea Cabins.
turns.answer:
**Winwood Ella**: Food 5.0/5, Staff 4.9/5, Rooms 4.9/5, Cleanliness 4.9/5, Location 4.8/5, Wi-Fi 4.6/5. Trust score 7.67/10, recent rating 4.26/5.
> "Just be prepared to take a tuk tuk back up the hill, which is all part of the Ella experience and offers some great views along the way." *(verified guest review)*
> "Breakfast was a real treat, featuring delicious traditional coconut rotti with homemade jam, fresh local fruits, and excellent tea and coffee." *(verified guest review)*

**Tea Cabins**: Food 4.9/5, Staff 4.8/5, Rooms 4.7/5, Cleanliness 4.7/5, Location 4.7/5, Wi-Fi 4.7/5. Trust score 7.8/10, recent rating 4.26/5.
> "The complimentary TukTuk rides made it so easy for us to go into Ella town centre and visit local attractions like Nine Arches Bridge, Ravanna Pool Club and Little Adams Peak." *(verified guest review)*
> "The development is still being completed, so lunch and dinner are currently served in your room, but we actually really enjoyed this as it made our stay feel even more private." *(verified guest review)*

verified_facts: Just be prepared to take a tuk tuk back up the hill, which is all part of the Ella experience and offers some great views along the way.
Breakfast was a real treat, featuring delicious traditional coconut rotti with homemade jam, fresh local fruits, and excellent tea and coffee.
Breakfast is served on your private terrace every morning and is freshly made.
The room was comfortable and spacious for a family of four.
The complimentary TukTuk rides made it so easy for us to go into Ella town centre and visit local attractions like Nine Arches Bridge, Ravanna Pool Club and Little Adams Peak.
The development is still being completed, so lunch and dinner are currently served in your room, but we actually really enjoyed this as it made our stay feel even more private.
They also provide a complimentary tuk tuk between the main road and the cabins, which is such a thoughtful touch and makes arriving and leaving effortless.
It felt so peaceful being surrounded by nature, and having breakfast served on our private porch every morning with that view was such a highlight.
